description:
Job Description & Summary

The opportunity

Accelerate pursuits and advisory engagements through compelling demonstrations, rapid prototypes and hands-on technical validation across Azure, data, AI and automation.

What you will be doing

Prototyping & demonstrations

  • Rapidly convert priority business use cases into demonstrations, proof-of-concept solutions and technical spikes.
  • Build clear, client-ready experiences that show workflows, data flows, controls and expected user interactions.
  • Prepare demo environments, scripts and supporting materials for workshops, proposals and executive presentations.
  • Capture reusable components, patterns and lessons learned.

Technical validation

  • Validate APIs, data access, integration patterns, model behavior, deployment options and non-functional requirements.
  • Estimate prototype effort and identify technical risks, constraints and prerequisites before larger mobilization.
  • Apply secure engineering practices, appropriate data handling and Responsible AI controls in prototype work.
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Architect on architecture decisions and with the Data & AI Manager on use-case intent and evaluation.

Advisory support & capability building

  • Contribute practical technical input to assessments, roadmaps, proposals and delivery plans.
  • Coach consultants on Microsoft demonstrations and support internal enablement sessions.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant Microsoft platform developments and assess their applicability to client needs.

What we need from you

  • 4+ years in cloud engineering, software development, data engineering, AI engineering or solution engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, APIs, identity, DevOps, data pipelines and modern application patterns.
  • Practical capability in Python or another modern language and experience building client-facing prototypes.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical behavior to non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, time-sensitive pursuit and discovery settings.

Preferred qualifications

  • AI-102, AZ-204, DP-600, DP-203 or PL-600 certifications are desirable.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, GitHub or Azure DevOps is advantageous.
  • Professional-services or pre-sales experience is preferred.

Measures of success

  • Speed and quality of prototypes and demonstrations
  • Accuracy of technical validation and risk identification
  • Reuse of accelerators and technical assets
  • Contribution to proposals, workshops and qualified opportunities
  • Adherence to security, data-handling and Responsible AI expectations

Key interfaces

  • Microsoft Cloud Architect and the other core team members
  • PwC Advisory sector and functional leaders
  • Cybersecurity, risk, privacy, legal, tax, deals, change and delivery specialists
  • Microsoft alliance and partner ecosystem stakeholders
  • Client executives, business owners, technology leaders and delivery teams
